body: Volunteering at Mary Joy Ethiopia is more than just lending a helping hand; it's about making a tangible difference in the lives of children and the elderly. By dedicating your time and skills, you become an integral part of a larger movement that strives to create a brighter future for vulnerable members of our community. Therefore, this form below is a form prepared to register the good-hearted people who are willing to volunteer for this good cause in Addis Ababa
